scope: Actual native drawer and isolated authenticated HTTP APIs; delayed delivery is a Playwright transport fault, not production network behavior
checks: closing and reopening retains the original source-scoped draft
unknown.bin has a safe honest result and no edit or force-preview action
oversized.txt has a safe honest result and no edit or force-preview action
missing.txt has a safe honest result and no edit or force-preview action
denied.txt has a safe honest result and no edit or force-preview action
failure and unavailable previews never start saving
late authenticated response cannot replace a different material preview
current assignee is not a second assignment action
real reassignment reads back the new assignee
ordinary assignment is not written as a formal historical handoff
no renderer script errors on recovery paths
